newsitem.title: USA: Boston Ed plans to form holding company.
newsitem.headline: Boston Ed plans to form holding company.

text.p: Boston Edison Co said Friday it asked the Massachusetts Department of Public Utilities to approve the initial investment in the formation of a holding company as the utility continues to restructure for the competitive marketplace.

A holding company will allow Boston Edison to separate regulated and unregulated business activities which, from a public policy perspective, minimizes the potential for unfair competitive business relationships between affiliates, the company explained.

Friday's filing is the first step in the holding company formation process, the utility said. Following DPU investment approval, Boston Edison will file a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in March and seek shareholder approval at its annual meeting in May.
With shareholder approval, Boston Edison will request DPU permission to proceed with the creation of the holding company.
The initial investment is not expected to exceed $600,000 which includes approximately $400,000 for the SEC filing fee. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
